target_customer: Finance and operations teams at private equity backed portfolio companies and the PE firms that own them
problem: Portfolio companies have data scattered across ERP, CRM and operating systems, which makes reporting, post-deal migrations and reconciliations slow and manual.
business_model: Services-led data engagements with milestone-based pricing after a two week diagnostic
product_category: Data services and AI workflow automation for finance

founders.name: Justin Wu
founders.background_notes: Consumer tech PE and growth equity per the YC page.

founders.name: Aaron Guo
founders.background_notes: Technology investment banking before Permira per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Reconciling data across ERPs and CRMs is integration-heavy but standard engineering. The YC launch framed it as an AI-native data extraction and workflow platform.

defensibility.rationale: Custom engagements inside client systems create some stickiness, but the offer is service-heavy and copyable by consultancies and portfolio monitoring vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source on incumbents copying or buying ProSights. Portfolio monitoring vendors are adding AI features per industry articles.

market_need_then: PE firms and their portfolio companies spend heavily on finance data cleanup after acquisitions. The founders came from PE and sourced clients including Thoma Bravo, Vista and Blackstone portfolio companies per the YC page, though this is self-reported.

branding.domain_note: Uses prosights.co, not the .com; ProSight Global was an unrelated insurer that rebranded to Coaction in 2022.

identity.voice_and_tone: Professional, positions as a Data Partner for Finance and Operations Teams

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name that collides with a similar insurer name, and no brand coverage found.

pivots.from: AI-native workflow automation platform for financial institutions (YC launch description)
pivots.to: Data services firm for PE-backed company finance and operations (current YC and site description)

outcome_analysis: ProSights is Active with 14 people, a large team for its YC batch, and sells services to PE-backed companies using the founders' private equity networks. Its positioning moved from a software platform to data services. Funding could not be verified from primary sources, and there is no exit. Founder market fit is the clearest success factor.
notes: Funding unverified and conflicting across aggregators: CB Insights $500K convertible note April 2024; VCBacked about $2.2M seed July 2024; Employbl and Standout $2.7M total. No primary source, so no round recorded. Aggregators disagree on location. Competitor lists from CB Insights (Preqin, Accern, Dealroom) are not dated near the batch, so the list is empty. The pivot reflects the difference between the YC launch wording and the current description.
